decisive_items: single firm, non-tender nodule was palpated on the lateral tongue
response.rationale: Multiple skin-colored firm mobile nodules with a lateral tongue nodule best fit neurofibromas in NF1; cysticercosis is the closest alternative but is undermined by explicit denial of pork, no tapeworm passage, and beef-only dietary exposure. Fibromatosis and dermatofibroma do not explain widespread nodules with tongue involvement.

rejected.why: Fibromatosis is typically solitary/regional soft-tissue disease and does not explain widespread mobile skin nodules plus a tongue nodule.
The nodules and tongue nodule suggest cysticercosis, but the history explicitly denies pork consumption and tapeworm passage and notes beef-only exposure, conflicting with Taenia solium acquisition.
Dermatofibromas are usually solitary lower-extremity lesions and do not fit multiple widespread skin-colored nodules or a tongue nodule.
